title: Steal A Kiss
author: Don Flaherty
problems: The progression after row 9 "robins start a half hey - rights in center, lefts on ends to long ocean wave larks out , robins in" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
Row 3 "balance wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
